$comment: The one generic ops-health config (agent/plans/PLAN-health-checks-local.md D-config). Thresholds and limits only: no host name, no IP and no target list.
The off-box Worker (workers/ops-health) bundles this file at build time and the Python side (rediacc_ci.ops) reads it, so no threshold is written twice.
Targets reach the Worker as the OPS_HEALTH_TARGETS secret at deploy time (rediacc_ci.ops.deploy_ops_health); per-service thresholds live in each repo's own health().
github_mentions: GitHub logins or org/team slugs, without the leading @, mentioned by scripts/ci/report-budget-check.cjs (D-alerts).
